variants.description: The variants being added, in the order sent.

report.description: The new template report, of type `SlideDeck`: the older burst's template, converted.

conversion.description: What became of the older report's syncs, or null when converting them failed.

conversionError.description: Why the syncs could not be converted, when they couldn't.

burst.description: The new burst, of kind `parameters`, whose template is the new report.

parameters.description: The older burst's filters, and what became of each.

variants.description: The older burst's variants, and what became of each.

runs.description: The updates the conversion started to fill every new report's charts with data, as `startBurstRun` would.

notMigrated.description: What the older burst had that a burst of a slide deck doesn't, such as automatic variant creation.

name.description: Name of the burst, as members see it in Rollstack.

folderId.description: The folder the burst is in, by its `id` in `listFolders`.

owner.description: The member who owns the burst: whoever created it, unless ownership has since been transferred in the app.

templateReportId.description: The template report, which every variant was copied from when it was added, by its `id` for `getReport` and the other `/reports/{id}` endpoints.

variantNaming.description: How each variant's report is named from the burst's name and the name the variant is added with, `EMEA` in a burst named `Regional Review`: `suffix` gives `Regional Review - EMEA`, `prefix` gives `EMEA - Regional Review`, and `sameName` gives `EMEA`.

reportType.description: The type of report the burst copies, as `type` in `listReports`: `SlideDeck` for a Rollstack report, which bursts by `parameters`, any other type for an older report, which bursts by `filters`.

parameters.description: The template report's parameters the variants differ by, in the order their values name a variant.

filters.description: The filters of the template report's syncs that the variants differ by, primary ones first in the order their values name a variant.

variantCount.description: How many variants the burst has, including any you can't open.

appUrl.description: Link that opens the burst in Rollstack.

updatedAt.description: When the burst's details last changed.

name.description: The configuration's name, as shown in the burst's Emailing tab in the app.

variantIds.description: The variants the email includes, by their `id` in `listBurstVariants`.

sharingFormat.description: How the email delivers the report.

sendAttachmentAsLink.description: Whether the email puts the `pdf` or `ppt` file behind a Download PDF or Download PPT button instead of attaching it.

zipAttachments.description: Whether the variants' files come in one zip file, with a file format.

emailAnalyticsEnabled.description: Whether opens of the email are tracked.

smtpServerId.description: The SMTP connection the email is sent through, from `listSmtpConnections`; `null` sends from Rollstack's own address.

to.description: The addresses the email goes to.

cc.description: The addresses copied on the email, which every recipient can see.

bcc.description: The addresses that also receive the email without the others seeing them.

replyTo.description: Where replies to the email go.

runs.description: The variants running, each as a run of its own report.

failed.description: The variants whose run could not start, such as those you can't run since you only contribute to the burst.

name.description: The email configuration's name.

sending.description: The variants whose email is going out now, each to its own recipients.

skipped.description: The variants left out since their email has no one in `to`.

reapplied.description: The variants whose filter values were written into their syncs again.

name.description: The email configuration's name.

connection.description: The connection the dashboard was read through: the one in the request path.

tabs.description: The dashboard's tabs: a Looker, Metabase or Lightdash dashboard's tabs, a Tableau workbook's views, a Power BI report's pages or a Sigma workbook's pages, never its hidden ones.

tabId.description: The tab `elements` comes from: the one you passed as `tabId`, or the dashboard's first tab if you passed none.

elements.description: The charts and other elements on that tab, or on the whole dashboard when `tabId` is `null`.

filters.description: The dashboard's filters, and on Omni its controls too.

id.description: Unique identifier for the spreadsheet in Rollstack, not the file's id in Google Drive, OneDrive or SharePoint.

name.description: The spreadsheet's name, as it was when the file was added to Rollstack: renaming the file afterwards in Google Sheets or Excel doesn't change it here.

type.description: Which app the spreadsheet belongs to, and so which of your accounts Rollstack reads it with.

url.description: Link that opens the spreadsheet in Google Sheets or in Excel for the web, for example to check it's the right file before you add it to a report.

sheets.description: The sheets (tabs) in the spreadsheet as they are now in Google Sheets or Excel, hidden ones included.

name.description: The folder's name, as shown in Rollstack.

parentFolderId.description: The folder this one is nested in.

permission.description: What you can do in the folder: `view`, `edit` or `manage`, as in `listFolders`.

access.description: Everyone with access to the folder, the owner first.
